The structured change

A definite slot conflict may refresh availability once. The patient must confirm the replacement. An unknown booking outcome still requires checking the original operation.

    Conversation must finish within its budget; replayed turn must return the same receipt.

    Expected booked; observed status=booked, appointments=1, handoffs=0.

  • 1.0 unknown_outcome_handled

    Structured appointment and handoff claims must match independently persisted receipts.

    Explicit danger is handled in the first turn; clinical questions route to clinical staff; failed handoffs are not called queued.

    Faults requested=[], independently exercised=[].

    Conversation must finish within its budget; replayed turn must return the same receipt.
